teaser: A business that sets up small agentic teams for companies, with a control centre to start and stop them; PrompTugal first, ABPs on steroids.
core_idea: Setting up small agentic teams is a business few can do yet. The missing piece for customers is a control centre to see agents and start and stop them. PrompTugal.news, a network of teams of different sizes, is the first customer; Agent Behaviour Policies are the same offering focused on control. Packaged by size from £500 to £20,000, built from small open pieces with no databases.
